_comment: "Once per Turn Action - {r}: Attack / If you have a card in your pitch zone with cost 0, this card's attacks get go again." Same shape as searing_emberblade, and the SOURCE_IS_ATTACK gate is load-bearing for the same reason: the card DB lists GoAgain unconditionally (it flattens the sentence), the engine treats every printed keyword as unconditional, and loader.conditional_keywords strips the printed copy ONLY for a static gated on SOURCE_IS_ATTACK. Without the gate the weapon would have go again permanently -- a free permanent buff. SOURCE_IS_ATTACK also reads 'THIS card's attacks' correctly: the weapon is the attacking card. The activation cost is NOT authored -- engine/card.py parses 'TYPE - COST:' and counts {r}, giving activation_cost 1 and a per-turn limit already, and a DSL declaration would only restate it. `cost: 0` is an EXACT cost match, which CARD_IN_ZONE reads through cost_gte/cost_lte both defaulting to it; 0 is a real cost in this game (Head Jab, Phoenix Flame) so the zero must not be treated as absent. Corpus: 4854 attacks, previously all skipped as unimplemented.
